function.description: Ask the OWNER for a decision the durable way, or record the owner's answer to an open ask. question=… raises (any session, never a leaf); answer=… decides (a genuine owner turn only). In an autonomous (goal/cron) run, a decision you need from the owner is an owner_ask, never a question in a message. In a live chat turn with the owner, offer the options with present_choice instead.
function.name: owner_ask

answer.description: ANSWER (owner turn only): the owner's decision, QUOTED from their message in this turn (e.g. "A"). Words that are not in the owner's message are refused.

ask_id.description: ANSWER: the ask to decide. Omit when exactly one ask is open.

question.description: RAISE: the decision or resource you need from the owner, as ONE question answerable in a word or two (name the options: 'A) … or B) …'). Durable, deduplicated, shown on every owner seat; the answer reaches this rail's next run. In an autonomous run, never ask this in a message instead.
